description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'SyncConflictResolver' responsible for resolving synchronization conflicts between local and remote CalendarEvent and Leave objects, presenting user dialogs to choose conflict resolution strategies.

classes.name: SyncConflictResolver
classes.description: A class that provides methods to resolve synchronization conflicts for CalendarEvent and Leave objects by prompting the user with dialogs.

methods.name: resolveEventConflict
methods.description: Prompts the user to resolve a conflict between local and remote CalendarEvent objects; supports options to keep local, keep remote, or merge.

methods.name: resolveLeaveConflict
methods.description: Prompts the user to resolve a conflict between local and remote Leave objects; supports options to keep local, keep remote, or merge.

methods.name: mergeEvents
methods.description: Merges two CalendarEvent objects, selecting the longer title and any available description, updating the lastModified timestamp.

methods.name: mergeLeaves
methods.description: Merges two Leave objects, selecting the longer title and any available description, updating the lastModified timestamp.
